headline: US Envoy Gor proposes Bangladesh join US-led Pax Silica initiative
summary: The proposal aims to strengthen technological cooperation and security ties between the two nations.
details: US Envoy Gor proposes that Bangladesh join the US-led Pax Silica initiative, a strategic partnership focused on technological advancement and security.
The initiative is designed to foster cooperation in critical and emerging technologies, ensuring secure and reliable supply chains for essential materials.
By joining Pax Silica, Bangladesh could potentially gain access to new investments, technological transfers, and enhanced security frameworks.
The proposal marks a significant step in deepening the diplomatic and economic ties between the United States and Bangladesh.
caption:
A new strategic partnership proposal from the US: Should Bangladesh join the Pax Silica initiative?

US Envoy Gor proposes that Bangladesh join the US-led Pax Silica initiative, a strategic partnership focused on technological advancement and security.

The initiative is designed to foster cooperation in critical and emerging technologies, ensuring secure and reliable supply chains for essential materials.

By joining Pax Silica, Bangladesh could potentially gain access to new investments, technological transfers, and enhanced security frameworks.

The proposal marks a significant step in deepening the diplomatic and economic ties between the United States and Bangladesh.

headline: Mirpur-10 metro station shut after suspicious bag found
summary: Police and bomb disposal units were deployed to Mirpur-10 and Farmgate stations after suspicious items were spotted.
details: The metro rail station at Mirpur-10 was temporarily shut down today after a suspicious bag was found on its first floor, prompting an immediate security response.
Police cordoned off the area around 12:00 pm after being alerted by metro rail authorities, and the station was officially closed at 1:10 pm.
A team from the DMP Bomb Disposal Unit arrived at the scene to examine the bag and determine if it contained any hazardous materials.
Mostak Ahmed, deputy commissioner (Mirpur Division) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, stated that confirmation of the bag's contents will only be possible after the inspection.
Simultaneously, another suspicious sack was spotted near a pillar close to the Farmgate metro rail station.
DMP Deputy Commissioner (Tejgaon Division) Md Ibne Mizan confirmed that the bomb disposal unit has been informed and is conducting an inspection of the second item.
caption:
Mirpur-10 metro station shut down after suspicious bags were found at two different locations.

The metro rail station at Mirpur-10 was temporarily shut down today after a suspicious bag was found on its first floor, prompting an immediate security response.

Police cordoned off the area around 12:00 pm after being alerted by metro rail authorities, and the station was officially closed at 1:10 pm.

A team from the DMP Bomb Disposal Unit arrived at the scene to examine the bag and determine if it contained any hazardous materials.

Mostak Ahmed, deputy commissioner (Mirpur Division) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, stated that confirmation of the bag's contents will only be possible after the inspection.

Simultaneously, another suspicious sack was spotted near a pillar close to the Farmgate metro rail station.

DMP Deputy Commissioner (Tejgaon Division) Md Ibne Mizan confirmed that the bomb disposal unit has been informed and is conducting an inspection of the second item.
